title: HSK 2
tagline: 8 thematic chapters · one theme per day · the new words of HSK 2

chapters.title: Travel, Weather & Best Time
chapters.intro: Talking about trips, sports and the best season to go.

grammar.title: Auxiliary 要 (yào): want / plan
grammar.rule: Expresses a desire or a plan — stronger than 想. Negative: 不想 / 不要.

examples.mean: I want to travel to Beijing.

grammar.title: Superlative 最 (zuì)
grammar.rule: Placed before an adjective or verb: 'the most / the -est'.

examples.pinyin: Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo.
examples.mean: September is the best time to visit Beijing.

grammar.title: Approximate numbers: 几 and 多
grammar.rule: 几 + measure word = a few (< 10). 多 after the measure word for numbers < 10; 多 before the unit for tens.

chapters.title: Daily Routine & Health
chapters.intro: Health, habits and your everyday routine.

grammar.title: Confirming with 是不是
grammar.rule: Used to confirm a guess. Placed before the predicate, or at the beginning / end of the sentence.

examples.hanzi: 你很少生病，是不是喜欢运动？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng, shì bu shì xǐhuān yùndòng?
examples.mean: You seldom get sick — you like sports, don't you?

grammar.title: 每 (měi): every
grammar.rule: 每 + measure word / noun means 'every'.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.
examples.mean: I get up at six every day.

grammar.title: Asking degree with 多
grammar.rule: 多 + adjective asks about degree (height, age, distance…).

chapters.title: Possession, Colors & Locations
chapters.intro: Saying what's yours, describing colours and where things are.

grammar.title: 的 standing alone
grammar.rule: Pronoun / adjective / verb + 的 can stand alone — the noun is omitted ('mine', 'the red one'…).

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì wǒ de.

grammar.title: 一下: short action
grammar.rule: After a verb, 一下 indicates a brief action. Equivalent to verb reduplication.

grammar.title: Exclamation with 真
grammar.rule: 真 + adjective expresses exclamation: 'really…!'

examples.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!
examples.mean: Your daughter's room is really beautiful!

chapters.title: Introductions, Work, Age & Comparison
chapters.intro: Introducing people, comparing things, talking about age and work.

grammar.title: 是…的: emphasis on the agent
grammar.rule: Emphasizes who did an already-known action. Negative: 不是…的.

examples.hanzi: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.
examples.mean: This job was recommended by him.

grammar.title: ……的时候: 'when…'
grammar.rule: Indicates the moment when something happens.

examples.hanzi: 我十一岁的时候开始踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shíyī suì de shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú.
examples.mean: I started playing football when I was 11.

grammar.title: 已经: already
grammar.rule: Indicates completion, or that a degree has been reached.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tī le shí nián le.
examples.mean: I've already been playing for ten years.

grammar.title: Comparison with 比
grammar.rule: A + 比 + B + adjective (+ difference). Negative: A 没有 B + adjective. Degree of difference: 一点儿, 一些, 多, 得多.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
examples.mean: He is three years older than me.
Watermelons are not as cheap as apples.

grammar.title: Verb phrase + 的 + noun
grammar.rule: A verb phrase can modify a noun as an attributive.

examples.pinyin: hé nǐ yīqǐ chàng gē de rén
examples.mean: the person who sang with you

grammar.title: 可能: maybe
grammar.rule: Expresses probability: perhaps, maybe.

chapters.title: Shopping, Clothes & Opinions
chapters.intro: Shopping for clothes, giving opinions, making plans.

grammar.title: 就: resolution
grammar.rule: 就 + verb indicates a conclusion or resolution. 就是 can introduce a concession.

examples.hanzi: 颜色还可以，就是有点儿大。
examples.pinyin: Yánsè hái kěyǐ, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr dà.
examples.mean: The colour is OK, but it's a bit big.

grammar.title: 还 + adjective: passable
grammar.rule: 还 + adjective = quite, fairly (acceptable).

grammar.title: 有点儿: slightly (negative)
grammar.rule: 有点儿 + adjective/verb = somewhat, usually with a negative connotation.

examples.mean: This garment is a bit large.

grammar.title: 再: again (future)
grammar.rule: Repetition or continuation in the future.

grammar.title: Pivotal sentences
grammar.rule: Subject + verb1 + person + verb2: the object of the first verb performs the second. Common verbs: 请, 让, 叫.

examples.hanzi: 老师让我给大卫打个电话。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi Dàwèi dǎ ge diànhuà.
examples.mean: The teacher asked me to call David.

grammar.title: Verb reduplication
grammar.rule: Indicates a short, casual action.

grammar.title: 怎么 + verb: why (with surprise)
grammar.rule: Asks for a reason, with a tone of surprise.

grammar.title: Measure-word reduplication: every
grammar.rule: Reduplicated nouns/measure words mean 'every / each', often with 都.

examples.hanzi: 这个星期天天都吃羊肉。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu.
examples.mean: Every day this week I've been eating mutton.

grammar.title: 因为…，所以…: cause and effect
grammar.rule: 因为 introduces the cause, 所以 the result.

examples.hanzi: 因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去打篮球。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú.
examples.mean: Because it rained yesterday, we didn't go play basketball.

chapters.title: Distance, Transport & Directions
chapters.intro: Getting around: distances, transport and directions.

grammar.title: 还: still
grammar.rule: Indicates continuation. Negative: 还没 (not yet).

examples.pinyin: Tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
examples.mean: He is still studying in the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái méi chī fàn ma?

grammar.title: 就: early / fast
grammar.rule: Emphasizes that something happens early, fast or smoothly.

examples.mean: It gets there in just 20 minutes.

grammar.title: 离: distance
grammar.rule: A 离 B + 远/近: the distance between two places.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
examples.mean: Is your home far from your company?

grammar.title: 着: continuing state
grammar.rule: Verb + 着 indicates a persisting state. Negative: 没…着. Question: …着没有?

grammar.title: 呢: confirming with emphasis
grammar.rule: At the end of a statement, confirms a fact with an exaggerated tone.

examples.hanzi: 坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！
examples.pinyin: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yī ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
examples.mean: It takes more than an hour by bus!

grammar.title: 不是…吗: rhetorical question
grammar.rule: Reminds someone, or expresses confusion: 'isn't it…?'

examples.pinyin: Tā bù shì yǒu nánpéngyou le ma?
examples.mean: Doesn't she already have a boyfriend?

grammar.title: 往: direction
grammar.rule: 往 + direction + verb: towards.

examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèr yīzhí wǎng qián zǒu.

chapters.title: Past Experiences, Frequency & Future Plans
chapters.intro: The grand finale: results, experiences, frequency and what's coming next.

grammar.title: Result complements
grammar.rule: A verb/adjective after the verb indicates the result: 看见, 听懂, 做完. Negative: 没 + verb + complement. Question: …(了)没有?

grammar.title: 从: starting point
grammar.rule: 从 marks the starting point in time, place or sequence. Often paired with 到.

examples.hanzi: 从下个星期一开始上班。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xià ge xīngqī yī kāishǐ shàng bān.
examples.mean: I start work from next Monday.

grammar.title: 第: order
grammar.rule: 第 + number (+ measure word): first, second…

grammar.title: Prohibition: 别…了 / 不要…了
grammar.rule: Dissuades or forbids: 'don't… anymore', 'stop…'.

grammar.title: 对: towards / for
grammar.rule: Indicates a subject–target relation.

examples.hanzi: 看电视对学汉语有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànshì duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.mean: Watching TV helps with learning Chinese.

grammar.title: Degree complements with 得
grammar.rule: Verb + 得 + adjective evaluates the action. With an object: 他汉语说得很好. Negative: 说得不好. Question: 说得好不好? 比 can be used inside.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ xué de hǎo.

grammar.title: Experience with 过
grammar.rule: Verb + 过 indicates a past experience. Negative: 没…过. Frequency: 次.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guò nàge diànyǐng méiyǒu?
Wǒ qù guò sān cì Běijīng.
examples.mean: I've been to Beijing three times.

grammar.title: 虽然…，但是…: although
grammar.rule: Concession: although…, but…

examples.pinyin: Suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì hěn lěng.

grammar.title: Imminent action: 要…了
grammar.rule: 要…了 / 快要…了 / 就要…了: something is about to happen. With a time adverbial, use 就要…了.

grammar.title: 都…了: already (emphatic)
grammar.rule: Means 'already' with a complaining or emphatic tone.

structures.name: 是…的 (emphasis on agent)
structures.rule: Subject + 是 + agent + verb + 的.

example.hanzi: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的。
example.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.
example.mean: This job was recommended by him.

example.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
example.mean: He is three years older than me.

structures.name: 过 (experience)
structures.rule: Verb + 过 (+ object): a past experience.

structures.name: 要…了 (imminent)
structures.rule: Subject + 要 + verb + 了: about to happen.

tones.rule: Disyllabic words: most stress the 2nd syllable (中重); a few stress the 1st (重轻)
Quadrisyllabic words: stress usually falls on the 4th syllable
Intonation: statements fall · 吗-questions rise · question words are stressed then fall · with 还是, first option rises, second falls

pitfalls.title: 要 vs 想
pitfalls.tip: 要 = want (plan / intention); 想 = would like (desire). Both are auxiliaries, but 要 is stronger.

example.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Běijīng. / Wǒ xiǎng hē chá.

pitfalls.title: 还 vs 再
pitfalls.tip: 还 = still (continuation); 再 = again (future repetition).

example.pinyin: Tā hái zài jiàoshì. / Míngtiān zài lái.

pitfalls.title: 就 (time)
pitfalls.tip: 就 emphasizes 'early / fast' — often with 了: 二十分钟就到了.

pitfalls.title: 得 vs 的 vs 地
pitfalls.tip: 得 for complements; 的 for possession / attributive; 地 for adverbials (地 is not in HSK 2).

example.pinyin: shuō de hǎo / wǒ de shū

pitfalls.title: 了 (le) position
pitfalls.tip: At the end of the sentence = change / completion; after the verb = completion (with an object).

example.pinyin: Wǒ qù shāngdiàn le. / Wǒ mǎi le shū.
